_comment: Unity 6 (6000.4.11f1). UGUI 2.0 already includes TextMeshPro. Textured GLB models are enabled: com.unity.cloud.gltfast loads the .glb props in StreamingAssets/Models at runtime, switched on by the GKMC_GLTFAST define in Assets/csc.rsp. UPM pulls glTFast's own dependencies (mathematics/burst/collections) automatically. To go back to procedural-only props, remove this package and the csc.rsp file (the code falls back automatically).
